title: Environmental Nucleic Acid Extraction from Filter Samples Using MagAttract Kit
author: Shu-Kuan Wong
materials: For DNA samples: Proceed to the RNase digestion step. To remove RNA contamination, add 2 µL of RNase A (10 mg/mL, Fermentas) to 20 µL of DNA and incubate for 3–4 hours at 37 °C. After enzyme digestion, remove the RNase A using Macherey-Nagel's NucleoSpin gDNA Clean-up Kit, following the manufacturer's protocol. For RNA samples, proceed to the DNAse digestion step using TURBO DNA- free ‱ Kit (Invitrogen, AM1907) and cDNA library preparation steps using PrimeScript‱ II 1st strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (TaKaRa, 6210A) .

For DNA samples: Proceed to the RNase digestion step. To remove RNA contamination, add 2 µL of RNase A (10 mg/mL, Fermentas) to 20 µL of DNA and incubate for 3–4 hours at 37 °C. After enzyme digestion, remove the RNase A using Macherey-Nagel's NucleoSpin gDNA Clean-up Kit, following the manufacturer's protocol. For RNA samples, proceed to the DNAse digestion step using TURBO DNA- free ‱ Kit (Invitrogen, AM1907) and cDNA library preparation steps using PrimeScript‱ II 1st strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (TaKaRa, 6210A) .

steps.title: Prepare Solution MBL
steps.instruction: Warm Solution MBL at 60°C for 15-20 minutes to dissolve precipitates. If extracting both DNA and RNA or only RNA, add 25 μL of β-mercaptoethanol (β-ME) to 975 μL of Solution MBL.

steps.title: Transfer Filter to Bead Tube
steps.instruction: Cut open the Sterivex cartridge with a tube cutter. Using a surgical scalpel (Akiyama MEDICAL MFG, Replacement blade No. 15) and two sets of sterile forceps, transfer the filter membrane into a 5 mL PowerWater DNA Bead Tube with the sample side facing inward.

steps.title: Remove RNAlater
steps.instruction: Expel the RNAlater from the Sterivex cartridge using a 10 mL syringe (TERUMO, SS-10SZ).

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of pre-warmed Solution MBL to each PowerWater DNA Bead Tube and disrupt the sample using a Microsmash Beads Beater (TOMY, MS-100).

substeps.instruction: Repeat disruption at 3,800 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation and Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PowerWater DNA Bead Tubes at 4500 x g for 1 minute at room temperature. Transfer the supernatant to a clean 5 mL tube (WATSON 233-150C), inserting the pipette tip through the beads to the bottom to maximize recovery.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of Solution IRS to each tube and seal with Parafilm.

substeps.instruction: Vortex horizontally at 500 rpm for 5 seconds using a Digital VORTEX-GENIE 2 (Scientific Industries, Inc, SI-A236).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 4500 x g for 6 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Clarify Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume of supernatant to a new 5 mL tube, avoiding the pellet. Centrifuge again at 4500 x g for 6 minutes at room temperature to remove residual particulates.

steps.title: Final Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Transfer all supernatant (~1 mL) to a new 5 mL tube (WATSON 233-150C), avoiding any residual pellet. If necessary, store at 4°C for several hours.

steps.title: Bind Nucleic Acids to Beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend ClearMag Beads by shaking or rocking the bottle (re-agitate every 3 minutes). For each preparation, add 20 μL of ClearMag Beads and 1 mL of ClearMag Binding Solution to the tube and seal with Parafilm.

substeps.instruction: Mix by placing the tube horizontally on a vortex at 500 rpm (VORTEX-GENIE 2) for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic Separation and Wash
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag™-5 Magnet (Invitrogen™, 12303D) for 3 minutes until beads adhere. Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Perform a total of 3 washes using 500 μL of ClearMag Wash Solution per wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of ClearMag Wash Solution and remove from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend beads by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing at lowest speed for 10 seconds.
Place on the magnetic stand for 3 minutes and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Remove any remaining wash with a 200 μL pipette tip. To ensure complete removal, leave tubes open in a biosafety hood for 5 minutes, place on the magnetic stand to remove remaining liquid, and dry again for 5 minutes or until beads are visibly dry.

steps.title: Elute Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 100 μL (for both RNA and DNA) or 50 μL (for RNA or DNA only) of Clear-Mag RNAse-free water.

substeps.instruction: Heat at 65°C for 5 minutes, flicking the tube occasionally to mix.
Place the tube on the DynaMag™-5 Magnet for 3 minutes.
Keep the tube on the magnet, open the lid, and transfer the eluate to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Use purified nucleic acids immediately or store at -80°C for long-term preservation.
